debrief: Both logging camps are captured and the pay ledger contradicts the Overseer’s report. Dain suspends his patrol’s attacks and agrees to protect Lark’s investigation in the central grove. The Overseer’s other guards have accepted no truce.
subtitle: Take their tools. Find the missing workers.
briefing: The village council licenses ordinary timber cutting, but its Overseer has sent crews into Alder’s sacred groves. He claims the pack killed the missing woodcutters. His tools and carts are stored in two guarded logging camps. Capture both camps to stop the cutting, and recover the workers’ pay ledger from the northern ruin. Captain Dain commands the patrol protecting those camps; leave him alive if you can.
hints: Capture both logging forts; standing in a marked grove does not stop the operation.
Search the northern ruin for the workers’ ledger.
Wolves cross woods easily. Boars and thorncaller staves fare better against armor.

intro.text: The council promised the villages repair timber. Its Overseer marked our sacred groves instead. His crews keep their tools and carts in those two forts.
Take the camps and the cutting stops. The northern post kept the workers’ records. Bring those back too.
My missing woodcutters were sent here. The Overseer says your pack killed them. I have orders to protect the crews that remain.
Your orders won’t tell us where they went. Their ledger might.
We need our roots back, not your bones. Keep away from our groves, captain, and help us find your people.

victory.text: Both camps are ours. Without their tools and carts, the crews have stopped cutting. Here is the ledger.
These men were marked as deserters, but their wages went to the Overseer’s own account. That is his seal. I cannot explain it.
Lark can ask the grove what happened. Come and watch her work.
Your pack has hurt my patrol, and mine has hurt yours. I am offering a truce for this investigation, not pretending that never happened.
